planning_notes: Board is arduino:avr:uno with authoritative pins D3 (button input) and D6 (buzzer tone output). No additional explicit wiring facts were provided, so only those two catalog requests are created.

Button polarity was not stated. The digital_input uses catalog defaults except active_high and pullup are explicitly set to active_high=true and pullup=false to match an unambiguous model where model=true corresponds to a pressed button.
Buzzer 'continuous发声' is implemented as a tone_output that the SysML model will drive to a nonzero frequency while the button is pressed, and set to 0 otherwise.
No serial requirements were provided, so serial_channels is empty.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Button press command gate (when true, start/continue buzzer tone requirement evaluation)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer continuous tone output while button is pressed
